prompts.front: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for a 2D children’s game. Input image: the reference pilot atlas; use its watercolor texture, expressive child proportions, ink line weight, and the size/shape of the bald head as strict alignment reference. Primary request: create a 4-column by 3-row contact atlas of twelve SEPARATE FRONT-VIEW HAIR OVERLAYS only, in this exact reading order: short cropped hair, soft curls, round afro, long straight hair, two braids, top bun, side-swept fringe, pigtails, afro puffs, mohawk, wrapped hijab, close shaved hair. Each cell contains one hairstyle fitted to the reference child’s head, with the top crown aligned to the bald scalp and side hair only where that style needs it. Style: high-quality hand-painted watercolor, soft paper grain, believable locks and highlights, child-friendly, consistent with the reference; natural deep chestnut as the base color so the game can recolor it later. Composition: exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, consistent scale and head alignment in every cell, generous transparent margin between cells; each hair shape viewed straight-on, isolated, centered, without a head. Constraints: true transparent background; hair only, no face, no ears, no skin, no neck, no hats unless the named style is hijab; no text, grid lines, numbers, shadows, collage overlap, white background or watermark. The sheet must be easy to crop into twelve equal cells.
prompts.back: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for a 2D children’s game. Input image 1: the bald pilot atlas, strict reference for head width/height and watercolor/ink technique; fit hair overlays onto the same child heads. Input image 2: the front hairstyle atlas, style/order reference for the same twelve exact hairstyles. Primary request: create a 4-column by 3-row contact atlas of twelve SEPARATE BACK-VIEW HAIR OVERLAYS only, in exactly the same reading order as Input image 2: short cropped hair, soft curls, round afro, long straight hair, two braids, top bun, side-swept fringe (show plausible rear silhouette), pigtails, afro puffs, mohawk, wrapped hijab, close shaved hair. Each hair shape must align to the back-view bald scalp in Input image 1, scale and crown height consistent with front atlas, and show natural rear volumes, nape and braids. Style: richly detailed hand-painted watercolor with paper grain, layered locks and warm chestnut highlights; natural deep chestnut base color to be recolored by game. Composition: exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, every hair centered and crop-ready, generous transparent margins. Constraints: true transparent background; hair only, no skin/head/ears/neck/clothing; no text, numbers, grid lines, hats except hijab, white background, cast shadow, overlap or watermark. Keep all twelve cells equally sized and aligned.
prompts.mobility: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent orthographic assistive-device sprite atlas for a watercolor 2D children's game. Input image: the bald pilot sprite sheet is a strict reference for scale, hand-painted watercolor texture, ink edge, colors and 2D sprite viewpoint only. Primary request: one exact 2-column by 2-row atlas, equal square cells, of four child-sized mobility devices with no person: top-left a pediatric manual wheelchair viewed straight from the front, top-right the same wheelchair from behind, bottom-left a lightweight pediatric walker viewed straight from the front, bottom-right the same walker from behind. Device design: the wheelchair has a clearly readable upholstered backrest and seat, stable frame, two moderate rear wheels with visible hand rims and spokes, small front casters and footrests; wheels must be realistic in proportion and sit beside the seat, not dominate the image. The walker is a lightweight four-foot frame with padded handgrips, side supports and small front casters; clearly recognizable from front and back. Each device is shown alone, vertically upright, centered, fully inside its own cell and at a scale that would fit around the seated or standing child in the reference. Style: elegant detailed hand-painted watercolor, soft paper grain, layered pigment, rounded friendly forms, thin navy ink outlines, muted teal metal and warm ochre fabric consistent with the reference art. Composition: straight-on flat 2D front/back views, no perspective tilt, no overlap between cells, clear transparent margins around each complete device. Constraints: real transparent background; devices only, absolutely no child/body/face/hands; do not add extra wheels, furniture, shadows, text, symbols, grid lines or watermark. Keep each of the four items distinct and crop-ready.
